name: Jiangshi x Daoshi
source:
When former assassin Luan is attacked by man-eating creatures, he is saved from certain death by a wandering dao priest, Ling Ling. At that time, neither of them know what tribulations yet await them.

[From [url=https://fruitbatfactory.com/daoshi/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
前刺客Luan遭到食人怪物袭击，流浪的道士Ling Ling救他逃过一死。那时，他们都不知道前方还有怎样的磨难等待着自己。

（来源：[url=https://fruitbatfactory.com/daoshi/]官方网站[/url]）
